ideons.name: Glass Leech
ideons.text: Drains 1 Ward from adjacent Wards whenever you place or activate a card. When commanded, heals its owner with its stored Ward. Killing it loses the reserve.

ideons.name: Glass Leech
ideons.text: Drains 1 Ward from adjacent Wards whenever you place or activate a card. When commanded, heals its owner with its stored Ward. Killing it loses the reserve.

enemies.name: The Kindly Hunger
enemies.signature: Creates two Ward-draining leeches, commands their healing, then threatens Insanity and mixed-element damage.
enemies.counter: Protect stored Ward by removing parasites before developing the engine.

enemies.name: Hollow Drifter
enemies.signature: A Hollow Sentinel protects it until destroyed. The Drifter flies over map barriers.
enemies.counter: Arcane attacks efficiently break the sentinel. Elemental attacks still work.

death.flavor: It asked for so little, until nothing remained.
death.summary: The Kindly Hunger killed you with Empty Embrace.
death.message: It asked for so little, until nothing remained. The Kindly Hunger killed you with Empty Embrace. Another traveler may find a different way.
